profile.headline: Backend SDE II at Expedia
profile.summary:
A University of Texas at Austin 2022 graduate with an interest in Software engineering and game development. Experienced in Object Oriented Programming, Algorithms, and game engines, and developed multiple projects over the years.

All my game prototypes can be found here: https://zephyrthezaunite.itch.io/

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer II
positions.description: Backend SDE II for the Trips Domain Team at Expedia in which collaborated with multiple teams to manage large-scale databases, develop collaboration features and trip auto-creation for Expedia travelers. resolve production issues on support rotations

positions.title: Frontend Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: Expedia Summer 2021 Remote internship in which I worked with the Ordering Services Team to create a UI web application with 2 other interns to view and edit ordering workflows in REACT/javascript.

positions.title: Reworld Game Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: I worked with a team of interns to create a game using the new Reworld engine, and we presented this game to industry officials in the Reworld company. My team worked on Alien Hates Avocados: a first person wave shooter where players protect cows from aliens using avocado guns.
positions.insights: Interdisciplinary Collaboration, Gameplay Programming and +3 skills

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

projects.title: Project JumpRat
projects.description: A solo developed 3D platformer prototype made in Godot using C++ GDExtension to create a custom made physics system and a custom camera system for the player character. I also designed the prototype level, animated the characters using Blender, and connected it to the events emitted from my custom system.

projects.title: Project Twitch - Prototype
projects.description: A solo developed top-down stealth-action roguelike game prototype with resource management, crafting systems, and 2 fully rigged and animated characters.
